name: 24CS256T-E/SM 256Kbit I2C Serial EEPROM
description: A 256 Kbit I2C-compatible Serial EEPROM built for industrial and embedded designs that need dependable non-volatile configuration storage in a tiny SOIJ footprint.

name: 83325/2-500-01 Outdoor Video Distributor Module
description: An ABB-Welcome outdoor video distributor module for door-entry video systems, distributing camera feeds to multiple indoor stations with reliable DIN-rail mounting.

name: DS89C450-MNL 8051 8-bit Microcontroller, 64K Flash
description: A high-speed 8051-compatible microcontroller with 64KB Flash and dual UARTs, ideal for legacy-compatible industrial control designs that still need 8051 instruction compatibility.

name: Edge IoT Connectivity Card M.2 nRF52840 (BLE/Thread/Zigbee)
mpn: EDGE IOT CONNECTIVITY CARD M.2 NRF52840
description: A compact M.2 form-factor connectivity card built around the Nordic nRF52840, dropping Bluetooth Low Energy, Thread, and Zigbee connectivity straight onto your carrier board's M.2 connector.
features: Onboard chip antenna, U.FL connector option
packageIncludes: 1 x Edge IoT Connectivity Card M.2

name: OKY3051-1 Atmospheric Temperature Sensor Module
description: A digital single-wire atmospheric temperature sensor module popular for weather-station, greenhouse, and environmental monitoring maker projects.

name: TSRASPI10-16GB Industrial microSD Card for Raspberry Pi
description: A 16GB Class 10 industrial-grade microSDHC flash card pre-qualified for Raspberry Pi boards, offering dependable boot storage for embedded and edge-compute deployments.

name: WarmMark QC OC/32°F 48-Hour Single Window Temperature Indicator
description: A single-window WarmMark temperature indicator label that turns red when a shipment has been exposed above 0°C/32°F for more than 48 hours — a simple, reliable cold-chain excursion sensor.
packageIncludes: 1 x WarmMark Indicator Label (pack of 10 available on request)

name: 1-101596-01 Differential Pressure Sensor
description: A rugged differential pressure sensor with analog output, measuring 125 to 125 psi differential — built for HVAC, medical, and industrial pressure monitoring applications.

name: HTU31D Board Mount Humidity & Temperature Sensor
description: The HTU31D is a digital 3D relative humidity and temperature sensor delivering factory-calibrated I2C readings for weather stations, HVAC, and industrial climate-monitoring designs.

name: RS1xx Bluetooth Multi-Sensor Data Logger
description: A wireless Bluetooth multi-sensor logger that tracks temperature, humidity, and more for supply-chain and cold-chain monitoring, syncing readings via a companion app.

name: LS03-1A66-PP-2000W Liquid Level Sensor
description: A reed-switch based liquid level sensor in a chemical-resistant polypropylene housing, ideal for float-style level detection in tanks and reservoirs.

name: MAX30105EFD+ Particle & Air Quality Sensor
description: An integrated optical sensor module combining red, IR, and green LEDs with a photodetector — widely used for particle sensing, smoke detection, and pulse-oximetry style applications.

name: PYTHON 25MP Mono CMOS Image Sensor
description: A high-resolution 25-megapixel monochrome global-shutter CMOS image sensor engineered for industrial machine-vision cameras that demand speed and accuracy.

name: Raspberry Pi Camera Module V2, 8MP (IMX219)
description: The official Raspberry Pi Camera Module V2 featuring an 8-megapixel Sony IMX219 sensor with fixed focus lens, connecting directly via ribbon cable to any Raspberry Pi board.
features: Ribbon-cable CSI connection, plug-and-play with Raspberry Pi
packageIncludes: 1 x Raspberry Pi Camera Module V2

name: T6743-40K-E Air Quality CO2 Sensor Module
description: An NDIR CO2 sensor module enclosed for refrigerant leak detection and indoor air-quality monitoring, delivering accurate, drift-resistant CO2 measurement.

name: WM-64K Omnidirectional Electret Condenser Microphone
description: A miniature omnidirectional electret condenser microphone cartridge with a flat frequency response, widely used in voice-capture and acoustic-sensing designs.

name: SP350YRGNQ LED Stack Light Industrial Indicator
description: A three-tier LED stack light for industrial machine-status signaling — Yellow/Red/Green segments give an instant visual read on line status from across the factory floor.

name: AHD16-6-125B010 6-Position Automotive Connector Housing
description: A rugged 6-position automotive connector housing with bayonet lock, built for demanding under-hood and industrial wiring harness applications.

name: MSIM-7-A Memory Card Connector, Push-In Auto-Eject
description: A 7-position push-in, auto-eject memory card connector for SIM/memory-card slots, mounted low-profile above the board for compact embedded designs.

name: BQ24032RHLR 1-Cell Li-Ion/Li-Polymer Battery Charger IC
description: A single-cell Li-Ion/Li-Polymer linear battery charger IC with integrated pass transistor, thermal regulation, and USB-friendly charge-current control.

name: UMP530F24-E 30W AC/DC Power Module, 24V Output
description: A compact 30W AC/DC power module delivering a regulated 24V output with high efficiency, suited for industrial control panels and embedded power designs.

name: AFBR-S6DPYEF101 High-Speed Fiber Optic Transceiver
description: A high-speed fiber optic transceiver module enabling reliable, noise-immune data communication over fiber for industrial and networking applications.

name: RC1604A-YHY-ESX 16x4 Character LCD Display Module
description: A 16x4 alphanumeric character LCD display module with a yellow-green backlight, a workhorse display for instrumentation and industrial control panels.

name: CXC3106A2027P Straight Plug Circular Connector, Crimp
description: A rugged straight-plug circular connector with crimp termination, built for industrial and embedded systems needing a dependable field-serviceable connection.

name: ST1W00854GR2000 Low-Profile Hinged microSD Connector, 8-Pin
description: A low-profile hinged 8-pin microSD card connector designed for space-constrained embedded and industrial boards requiring removable storage.

name: OSK2056A-IR Infrared Emitting LED
description: A through-hole infrared emitting LED for proximity sensing, remote-control, and IR-communication designs, offering consistent output across production batches.

name: LTS-3401LWC Single-Digit 7-Segment LED Display
description: A white single-digit 7-segment LED display module used in instrumentation panels, counters, and consumer-facing numeric readouts.
